text: Son, 2, temp 38.1. Found some small dark purple spots, he's got dark skin so I checked the soles of his feet and inside his mouth where it's lighter, they're there too and don't fade when I press a glass on them. His hands and feet are cold and he's shivering even with the fever. That said, between doses he's playing and drinking, nappies wet, wide awake watching telly and chatting. What should I do.
